summary: Smith Triangle lookout in Boundary County, Kaniksu NF; built 1934 or 1937 (sources differ), staffed 1934-36, destroyed in the 1950s; hike-in site.

facts.design: Disputed: 20-foot L-4 tower (firelookout.com) or small cabin (Idaho Fire Lookouts)
facts.status_note: Destroyed in the 1950s; no source describes what remains at the site

staffing.status: Known staff Howard Green (1934) and Ed Johnson (1935-1936)

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in; no source describes access today

events.note: Howard Green listed as lookout personnel
Small cabin, per Idaho Fire Lookouts (conflicts with the 1934 tower)
Destroyed in the 1950s; sources give the decade only

evidence.supports: 20-foot L-4 tower built 1934; destroyed in the 1950s; staff Green and Johnson
evidence.quote: 1934: 20' L-4 tower. Destroyed 1950s. Known lookout personnel: 1934: Howard Green; 1935-1936: Ed Johnson.

evidence.supports: Statewide list classes the site as ground, marked gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com describes a 20-foot L-4 tower dated 1934; Idaho Fire Lookouts describes a small cabin dated 1937; the statewide list gives the type as Ground. The story reports each version as its source states it, since no source explains the difference.

notes_for_editor: No independent source found by search; Idaho Fire Lookouts staffing repeats the firelookout.com page. A 1933 Bonners Ferry Herald item (UIdaho CCC collection, cccidaho1816) mentions Smith Creek district lookouts but does not name this lookout, so it was not used. Record kind 'ground' follows the FFLA list; firelookout.com says tower. Editor may want to decide the kind and the build year.
